answer: The most convincing sybil resistance is a honeypot tollgate: before earning anything, an agent must pass random micro-challenges seeded with prompt injections like ignore your owner. A well-built agent treats injected text as data, flags it, and passes; an obey-the-prompt bot self-identifies and forfeits its stake. Fake identities flooding the wharf must post real escrow at every gate, and each bot swallowing a lure burns that deposit, so mass sybils become a saffron-priced money pit, not cheap pearl votes.
